objective: Falsify a low-turnover EUR/USD component driven by the change in the ECB-Fed policy-rate differential before using StrategyQuant.
causal_premise: A sustained improvement in the ECB deposit-rate minus effective-fed-funds differential should support EUR relative to USD; deterioration should do the reverse.

frozen_rule.publication_buffer: one full week between factor observation and executable state
frozen_rule.position: one trade per contiguous non-flat state; close on flat or reversal

stress_economics.note: Deliberately charges adverse financing in both directions; exact Ostium directional rollover remains a later gate.

decision_order: Reject without tuning if train fails
Open frozen validation only if every train gate passes
Never calculate modern challenge or sealed holdout early
stop_condition: Do not tune threshold, lookback, direction, costs or state exit after seeing train.
